title: 1 Oversold Stock Primed to Rebound and 2 We Brush Off
summary: The past year hasn’t been kind to the stocks featured in this article. Each has tumbled to its lowest point in 12 months, leaving investors to decide whether they’re witnessing fire sales or falling knives.

title: What Has Home Depot Stopped Telling You About Where Its Goods Come From?
summary: Home Depot (HD) stock has lost about a quarter of its value over the past year, while the S&P 500 gained close to 17%. Where the goods on its shelves come from used to be something management explained at length. Now you mostly hear how fast they arrive.

title: Is Lowe's Cheap Because Nobody Noticed Its Growth?
summary: Lowe's Companies (LOW) grew revenue faster over the past twelve months than any of the five companies it is ranked against. It is also the cheapest of them on earnings. That combination normally means the market has missed something. Here it looks more like the market is reading the growth differently than the rank does.

title: 3 Reasons SYF Has Explosive Upside Potential
summary: Synchrony Financial’s 18.8% return over the past six months has outpaced the S&P 500 by 5.1%, and its stock price has climbed to $76.06 per share. This was partly thanks to its solid quarterly results, and the performance may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.

title: Ulta Beauty faces rising customer backlash over anti-theft tool
summary: Ulta Beauty encounters mounting pressure as customer opposition to an anti-theft measure at its locations grows.

title: Can Home Depot Manage Tariff & Logistics Pressures on Margins?
summary: HD is leaning on tariff refunds, pricing, sourcing and supply-chain actions to protect margins as fuel, energy and input costs stay elevated.

title: Why Lowe’s CMO Jen Wilson added digital commerce to her portfolio
summary: The addition of Lowes.com and Marketplace to a purview that includes retail media, loyalty and personalization speaks to the evolution of the marketer role.

title: Home Depot vs. Lowe’s: One Payout Will Weather the Storm — Here’s Which
summary: With existing home sales at historic lows and renovations drying up, both Home Depot and Lowe's face the same brutal headwind, but only one dividend has the cushion and growth runway to outlast a frozen housing market.

title: Five Dividend Stocks Crushing Inflation With Consistent Dividend Payout Growth
summary: A static dividend yield quietly loses ground every month inflation climbs, but five companies have been raising their payouts fast enough to fight back. The question is which ones have the cash flow to keep doing it.
